subject: math

objective.text: Count by fives around the clock. Tell time to the nearest five minutes.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective: Tell time to the nearest five minutes.

explanations.title: Each number is 5 minutes
explanations.text: From one number to the next is 5 minutes. Count by fives all the way around: 60 minutes.

explanations.title: Reading the time
explanations.text: Look at the hour hand first. Then count by fives to the minute hand. 7:35 is seven thirty-five.

explanations.title: Start from half past
explanations.text: For 7:35, start at half past, 30. Then count 35. This is faster.

source_ref.section: Concept Development: 'start at half past, or 30, and counting by 5'

examples.title: Not five o'clock yet
examples.text: At 4:55 the hour hand is very close to the 5. But it is not five o'clock yet. 5 more minutes are needed.

misconceptions.label: Reading the next hour too early
misconceptions.description: When the hour hand is very close to the next number (like at 4:55), the child reads the next hour.
detection_signals: Says 5:55 or five o'clock for a clock showing 4:55.
Says the hour that the hour hand is closest to, not the one it has passed.
misconceptions.response_text: The hour hand is close to the 5, but it has not reached it. It is still 4. The time is 4:55.

source_ref.section: Concept Development: 'Notice how very close the hour hand is to the 5. But is it five o'clock yet?'

assets_required.why_this_method: Hand positions must be exact, and the hour hand must move partway between numbers. Diffusion cannot do this.
assets_required.description: An analog clock with numbers 1-12, minute marks, an hour hand and a minute hand. Can also show a digital readout.
must_show_exactly: Numbers 1-12 in correct positions, 60 minute marks
Minute hand points exactly at the stimulus minute
Hour hand sits between hours in proportion to the minutes (for example halfway between 3 and 4 at 3:30)
q_pr_6: exactly 7:35, hour hand a little past halfway from 7 to 8
q_pr_4, q_pr_5: exactly 4:55, hour hand very close to the 5
states_or_frames: any time hh:mm from the stimulus
minute numbers 5-60 shown outside the face
assets_required.interaction: Display, or the child drags the hands. The tutor sets the time from the question stimulus.
assets_required.alt_text: A clock face with an hour hand and a minute hand.
assets_required.generation_caption: Clean flat analog clock face, numbers 1 to 12, two hands, plain white background, no text. [Build by code]

assets_required.generation_caption: Flat analog clock face with a highlighted minute hand, white background. [Build by code]

visual_generation_rules: Diffusion cannot count reliably. Any picture where an exact number of objects matters must be built by code (SVG or widget) or drawn by an artist.

Every visual must be checked by a person: the count shown must equal the stimulus in the question and the rubric answer key.
Animations are described as frames with exact counts per frame, so they can be built or generated and then checked frame by frame.
